healthcare.intro: Sub-niches cover general practice, hospitals, specialist clinics, dental and eye care, mental health, rehabilitation, pharmacy and veterinary care. Every site includes a safety line where the niche needs one, clear ways to book or refer, and sample copy written for that kind of practice.
readme: Names, people, addresses, phone numbers, prices, opening hours, waiting times and turnaround times in this theme are fictional sample content. Replace all of it with your own.
This theme is a design. It is not medical advice, and it does not make a site compliant with any health, privacy or advertising rule. Check that yourself.

The forms are static sample markup in Custom HTML blocks. They do not send anything. Replace them with a form plugin you trust, and do not collect health information through a form unless your setup is built for it.

real-estate.intro: Sub-niches cover agencies, solo agents, apartment communities, property managers, luxury and commercial agencies, holiday rentals and new-home builders. Property layouts include a search with a map of numbered listings and a featured home with a floor plan, and every site has sample copy written for that kind of business.
readme: Names, people, addresses, phone numbers, listings, prices, rents and fees in this theme are fictional sample content. Replace all of it with your own.
This theme is a design. It is not legal or financial advice, and it does not make a site compliant with any fair housing, licensing or advertising rule. Check that yourself.

The forms are static sample markup in Custom HTML blocks. They do not send anything. Replace them with a form plugin you trust, and do not collect identity or financial details through a form unless your setup is built for it.

medical.intro: For a family or general practice: registration, repeat prescriptions, test results and how to get an urgent appointment, written for patients who want a practical answer.

hospital.intro: For a community hospital: departments, outpatient clinics, a minor injuries unit, visiting times and how to find your way around the site.

cardiology.intro: For an outpatient heart practice: a route for patients, a separate route for referring clinicians, a plain guide to each test, and emergency guidance near the top of the page.

dermatology.intro: For a skin clinic with medical and cosmetic sides: mole checks, patch testing and a route for referrers, kept apart from cosmetic treatments.

pediatrics.intro: For a children's clinic: well visits, sick visits and newborn care, with routing to the right visit and no symptom lists.

fertility.intro: For a fertility clinic: first conversations, tests and treatment options in a plain order, including stopping or taking a break. No success rates.

dental.intro: For a family dental practice: check-ups, hygiene, fillings and emergencies, with a new patient guide, guide prices and what to do about a dental emergency.

orthodontics.intro: For a braces and aligner practice: consultations for children and adults, how treatment runs from first look to retainers, and general time ranges that are labelled as not a promise.

therapist.intro: For a counselling practice: who it may and may not be right for, how a first session goes, fees and cancellation, and clear crisis signposting.

mental-health.intro: For a group outpatient mental health clinic: assessment, therapy, group programmes and medicine reviews, a named care coordinator, referral from doctors, and crisis signposting on every page.

physical-therapy.intro: For a physical therapy and rehab clinic: assessments, sports rehab, pelvic health and classes, with a route for surgeons and doctors who send patients.

optometry.intro: For an independent eye care practice: eye tests, children's vision, contact lenses and frame fitting, with what to do about sudden changes in vision.

pharmacy.intro: For a community pharmacy: repeat prescriptions, medicine reviews, vaccinations, minor ailment advice and travel health, with branch hours and when to see a doctor instead.

veterinary.intro: For a small animal vet: consultations, vaccinations, neutering, dental care and repeat prescriptions, with new pet registration and an out-of-hours line.

real-estate.intro: For a residential agency: homes to buy and rent, valuations for sellers, lettings and management for landlords, fees in plain words and a payment-fraud warning.

real-estate-agent.intro: For a solo agent with a small team: current listings, how buying and selling with one agent works, the agent's fee and a way to book a call.

apartment.intro: For a rental apartment community: floor plans with rents, available homes and move-in dates, fees and pet terms, tours and a path for current residents.

property-management.intro: For a residential property manager: plans and fees for owners, available rentals, and a tenant section for rent, repairs and the emergency line.

luxury-real-estate.intro: For a boutique agency of high-value homes: a featured estate with a floor plan, price on request, private viewings with identity checks and discreet sales.

commercial-real-estate.intro: For a commercial agency: offices, shops and industrial units with size, rent per sq ft and use, lease terms explained and a path for landlords and investors.

vacation-rental.intro: For a small holiday rental company: stays with sleeps and nightly prices, booking terms, check-in steps, house rules and a path for owners.

home-builder.intro: For a new-home builder: communities, home plans and move-in-ready homes, the build process, standard and upgrade options, and sales centre hours.
